item.title: How the Real Linus's Words in the LTT Video Cured My Anxiety
item.description: Although I had seen this widely circulated quote before, I didn’t know its source at the time. Recently, by chance, I learned about LTT and how Linus used AI to fix Linux bugs, mentioning how difficult the process was and how much help he received from AI. Then I happened to come across this video. Although it’s a video from late 2025, the topics discussed in it almost completely dissolved my anxiety about AI and overturned some of my own thinking.
